decisions.reason: As the flagship option, it remains strategically important and is still low cost to keep while uncertainty about cloud email demand resolves.
Document capture supports digital business processes, so the option may still hold value and has not yet shown clearly negative results.
Email-fax conversion is a legacy bridge with declining relevance and no website presence, signaling that its value is unlikely to be realized.
Fax delivery optimization is close to legacy fax and likely integrated into existing services, so as a separate product it has low option value.
Email sandbox threat protection has not shown enough traction and can be folded into core email security, so the separate option is no longer justified.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a commodity feature likely absorbed into the main email service, leaving little value as a standalone option.
